trigger.description: `ee focus suggest --task-frame <id>` resolved a task frame whose `evidence_links[]` contains no memory-kind entries (the frame is empty or only carries non-memory references such as `context_pack`/`handoff`/`bead`). Per the explicit-scope contract the pipeline returns empty `recommendations[]` rather than silently broadening to every recent memory, and emits this degraded entry so the caller knows why the scope was honored.
